title: Darth Bane
description: Darth Bane was an ancient, legendary Sith Lord, but also a visionary who realized that the traditions of the Sith would lead to their doom. After the Sith were decimated by the Jedi a thousand years prior to the Clone Wars, he enacted the rule of two in order to guard their secrecy and ensure the survival of the Sith. Yoda encountered a vision of the Sith Lord in a Sith Temple on Moraband.
